evidence.quote: We propose $35 million for automatic payments to the class, plus $7 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
We can reduce our proposed fee request to $6 million, but seek a $32 million class fund.
Any fee reduction would increase class relief.

summary: Class counsel raised fees alongside its initial class-fund proposal, and both amounts changed before the parties agreed on relief. The terms expressly directed any unawarded fees to the class. The transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class recovery for its fees, defense exploiting fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
